description: This file implements an OpenPipe-specific extension of the OpenAI Large Language Model (LLM) service within the Pipecat project. It provides a class `OpenPipeLLMService` that integrates with OpenPipe's API, enabling fine-tuning, monitoring, and enhanced logging features tailored for OpenPipe.

classes.name: OpenPipeLLMService
classes.description: A service class that extends the OpenAILLMService to integrate with OpenPipe's platform, offering enhanced features like tagging and logging for LLM interactions.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, model: str = "gpt-4.1", api_key: Optional[str] = None, base_url: Optional[str] = None, openpipe_api_key: Optional[str] = None, openpipe_base_url: str = "https://app.openpipe.ai/api/v1", tags: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OpenPipeLLMService with model configuration and API keys, and sets up tags and other parameters.

methods.name: create_client(self, api_key=None, base_url=None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the OpenPipe AsyncOpenAI client, configured with provided API keys and URLs.

methods.name: dict build_chat_completion_params(self, params_from_context: OpenAILLMInvocationParams)
methods.description: Builds the parameters dictionary for chat completion requests, adding OpenPipe-specific logging and tagging options.
